blocks.orig: Hatari Lodge is beautifully located inside the boundaries of Arusha National Park, and as such it’s a wonderful place to stay in the middle of nature in a building reminiscent of colonial times. The spacious and cosy rooms are beautifully furnished in a modern retro style with an African touch, with thatched roofs and black-and-white tiled floors. The lodge’s location allows you to see giraffes and other wild animals passing by, both from your own room and from the communal areas. On top of that, the Hatari Lodge boasts a good kitchen, a bar, an outside terrace and a viewing platform stretched out into the savannah where animals can come and say hi. A beautiful experience!
blocks.html: Set within the boundaries of Arusha National Park, Hatari Lodge has a beautiful location, which makes it a lovely place to stay surrounded by nature, in a building that recalls colonial times. The roomy, cosy rooms are attractively decorated in a modern retro style with an African feel, featuring thatched roofs and black-and-white tiled floors. Thanks to where the lodge is, you can watch giraffes and other wild animals wander past, both from your room and from the shared spaces. In addition, Hatari Lodge has a good kitchen, a bar, an outdoor terrace and a viewing platform reaching out into the savannah, where animals may come by to say hello. A lovely experience!
